intro: Black Friday prices on the in-stock machinery in our Mississauga, ON warehouse, ready to ship, and 5% off any machine you order from the factory by December 4. Ask for an instant quote and the price list with full specifications is in your inbox within minutes.

faq.q: How does the instant quote work?
faq.a: Fill in the form with your company details and the machines you are interested in. The Black Friday price list, with the sale price and the full specifications of every in-stock machine, is emailed to you within minutes. Reply to that email or call us to reserve a machine.

faq.q: Why are the prices not on the page?
faq.a: Black Friday prices go to buyers directly by email, so every buyer gets the full price list, the specifications and the terms in one place.

faq.q: Are these machines really in stock?
faq.a: Yes. They are in our warehouse at 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON, ready to ship, and you can see them before you buy: call +1 647 526 5510 to book a visit. In-stock machines are first come, first served.

faq.q: How long do the Black Friday prices last?
faq.a: Until Friday, December 4, 2026, at 11:59 pm Eastern time, or until the machine is sold.

faq.q: What if the machine I need is not in stock?
faq.a: Order it from the factory by December 4 and take 5% off. You pay only 10% down to confirm the order and the remaining 90% on delivery.

faq.q: Can I write the machine off this year?
faq.a: Canadian businesses can deduct 100% of the cost of eligible manufacturing and processing equipment in the tax year it becomes available for use, and eligible Ontario corporations can also claim the 15% Ontario Made Manufacturing Investment Tax Credit. Eligibility depends on your business and how the machine is used, so ask your accountant. A machine from stock can be delivered and running before your year-end.
